column2: 使用 skills/goai-lit-search/SKILL.md。针对 LLZO garnet solid electrolytes 主题，按 balanced/comprehensive 级别执行完整检索：覆盖 9 个 scope 子主题，强制完成近邻/同型体系和相图/热力学检索面，运行滚雪球、下载可得 OA PDF、写 search_log，最后由你作为汇合者运行 coverage_report 与 export_bibtex；把 lit_coverage gate 置为 PASS 或按规则 WARN，并记录 loopctl 日志。GOAI_WORKSPACE=/home/gaojing/goai_synthesis_runs/20260903_synthesis_topics/01_llzo。第三列关键产物：/home/gaojing/goai_synthesis_runs/20260903_synthesis_topics/01_llzo/library/papers.jsonl,/home/gaojing/goai_synthesis_runs/20260903_synthesis_topics/01_llzo/library/references.bib,/home/gaojing/goai_synthesis_runs/20260903_synthesis_topics/01_llzo/notes/search_log.md
